name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd (GRSE)
tagline: Debt-free defence PSU shipyard with 43% ROCE and a diversifying order book — but already crossed into large-cap territory
business_overview: GRSE is a Kolkata-based defence PSU shipyard supplying the Indian Navy and Coast Guard, with a growing non-defence shipbuilding order share (25% of order book now, up from 2% five years ago). Recent execution highlights include anti-submarine shallow watercraft (4 of 8 delivered ahead of schedule) and P17 Alpha frigates (2 of 3 delivered ahead of schedule).
fundamentals_narrative: Exceptional capital efficiency (43% ROCE, 31.8% ROE) and a genuine ~40% 3-year revenue CAGR, on a debt-free balance sheet — as strong a fundamentals profile as any stock in this batch. The catch is size: at ~Rs 29,814 Cr market cap the stock has already 'cleared the large-cap threshold' per one financial-media report from Aug 2026.
technical_read: Not independently pulled this pass; 52-week range Rs 1,964-3,339, near the high end as of the last thread update (Aug 2026).

bull_case: 43% ROCE / 31.8% ROE on a debt-free balance sheet is an exceptional combination for a company this size
40% 3-year revenue CAGR reflects real order execution, not just re-rating
Diversifying order book (25% non-defence now vs 2% five years ago) reduces single-theme dependency
India's naval/Atmanirbharta shipbuilding push is a genuine, multi-year structural tailwind
